about_the_game:
Master the rhythm as you engage in fast-paced turn-based duels inspired by a traditional Japanese party game.

                           

Choose your opponents, outmaneuver them with precise timing, and build powerful synergies with active and passive upgrades. Victory requires more than mere skill, you must carefully manage your resources to advance to tougher challenges.

                             

A Unique Rhythm Roguelike Experience

  • Fast-paced, rhythm-driven gameplay that blends strategy with reflex-based dueling.

  • Every decision matters. Pick fights wisely, earn points, and balance spending on upgrades while saving enough to progress.

  • Endless replayability with randomized enemies and evolving difficulty 


                             

Strategic Upgrades & Deep Combos

Shape each run with a variety of upgrades that alter your approach to battle:

  • Active & Passive Abilities – Enhance your reactions, disrupt your opponent, and optimize your rhythm-based tactics.

  • Dynamic Enemy Scaling – Face tougher, smarter enemies as you progress, forcing constant adaptation.

  • Procedurally Influenced Battles - No two duels play out the same, keeping every match fresh and unpredictable.

                           

                           

Developer's Note

Konpira Fune Fune is a fully independent passion project, built from the ground up by a solo developer with no external funding or paid assets. Every element, game design, programming and music has been crafted with dedication.

To streamline the creative process, AI-assisted tools were used to enhance and accelerate artwork production, ensuring a distinctive visual style while maintaining full artistic direction.

This game was crafted with care, and I truly hope you have fun playing it!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12 (Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM

short_description: Konpira Fune Fune is a 2D roguelike rhythm duel demanding sharp reflexes and strategy. Choose opponents, earn points, and invest in passives and actives to create potent combos! Save enough to unlock tougher stages while powering up to survive each challenging battle.
